newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine farmers harvesting in fine weather.
newsitem.headline: Argentine farmers harvesting in fine weather.

text.p: Argentine farmers were taking advantage of sunny weather Friday to speed their 1996/97 wheat harvest to its conclusion, traders said.
"The weather's good out in the wheat belt, although it looks like it might rain on Sunday," one trader told Reuters.

The Argentine government's Meteorological Service said weather should be fine in most parts of the grain belt, but there was a possibility of isolated storms in northern La Pampa, northern Santa Fe and southern Cordoba later Friday.
Weather Services Corp forecast mostly dry weather.
Maximum temperatures in the grain belt were forecast to range from 70 degrees Fahrenheit (19 degrees Celsius) to 83 degrees F (28 degrees C).
